description: Filter trail summaries from /api/v1/trails. Each distance and elevation stays the feed object (value, source, verifiedDate, provisional). Figures are sourced and dated. They may be provisional. Cite the trail URL and the verifiedDate. Permit status is verified-official, reported-secondary, or unverified, or null when the feed has none. Null means not recorded. This server does not invent figures. A returned figure can be verified with get_provenance and the record signature.
name: search_trails
title: Search trails
